info.name: Get data for insights reports summary

params.name: reportType
params.description: Required. Report Type. Valid inputs are: "quarterly", "yearly"

params.name: currency
params.description: Optional. If not set, default value is `USD`.

items.docs: Get data for insights reports summary

params.name: accountId
params.description: Required. The AWS account ID to assume when querying CloudWatch.

params.name: region
params.description: Required. The AWS region where the metrics should be queried (e.g., "us-east-1").

params.name: type
params.description:
Required. The type of metadata to retrieve.
Valid values: "namespace", "metric", or "dimension".

params.name: namespace
params.description:
Conditionally required.
Must be provided when `type` is "metric" or "dimension".
Example: "AWS/EC2", "AWS/Lambda", or a custom namespace like "MyApp/BusinessMetrics".

params.name: metricName
params.description:
Conditionally required.
Must be provided when `type` is "dimension".
Example: "CPUUtilization", "Invocations", etc.
